text_summary.body: Daniel speaks of the king of the south, angered, defeating the great army of the king of the north but not prevailing. (The text names no one; the correlation is the interpreters'.)

setting.body: Antiochus III had recovered much of Coele-Syria; Ptolemy IV met him near Raphia. Polybius describes Antiochus's wing succeeding while his left and phalanx broke; Antiochus withdrew with heavy losses, Ptolemy recovered Coele-Syria and agreed a one-year truce.

not_applicable.commentary: Interpretive commentary is recorded on the Daniel 11 prophecy records.
not_applicable.competing_reconstructions: No competing reconstruction of the event itself found in the sources read.
